messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] working with ax13339 cdf
parts:
Hi,

I've had a look at the CDF you sent me offline. I've had a look at
the structure, and although one could guess that it is a CDF for SNP
chip, the structure is totally different from all other Affymetrix SNP
chip CDFs. None of the methods in aroma.affymetrix for SNP/CN
analysis will work with this CDF structure. If that is wanted, the
"fastest" approach is to create a new CDF that follows the structure
of all the other SNP chip CDFs.

The dimension of the ax13339 chip type is 712x712, which is also the
dimension of the Mapping10K_Xba131 chip type. There is a small
possibility that these two chip types are actually identical (same
production masks used) and that it is only the CDFs that differ. If
so, CDFs for the Mapping10K_Xba131 chip type could be used. Note
though, that that is just a wild guess/hope and need to be checked
further. Moreover, all units in the CDF are listed as 'CustomSeq'
units (unit type 1);

cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType("ax13339");
unitTypes <- getUnitTypes(cdf);
table(unitTypes);
unitTypes
1
10043

and not as 'Genotyping' (unit type 2) as expected if they would be SNP units.

I have at least created a new page for this chip type, where we can
add new information if found:

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/ax13339

If anyone else have pointers/references to the origin of the ax13339
CDF, please let me/us know.

Cheers

Henrik
